Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.

Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base

Mineral specimens of this depth and crystal coverage make striking decorative display pieces for geological collectors, interior decor, or meditation spaces.
Deep hollow geode cavity lined with rich purple amethyst crystal points
Rough, unpolished exterior matrix providing a stable freestanding display base
Sparkling crystalline quartz druzy interior with varied crystal point sizes

Natural geological specimen with organic variations, surface inclusions, and raw textural variations inherent to natural rock.
